provenance: Format fixture for the C7h effective-privilege audit. 'real-operator' is REAL `sudo -n -l` output captured read-only for the current user on the controller host (sudo 1.9.17p2, 2 Oct 2026), sanitised for portability: user and host renamed, command paths replaced by neutral names with the SAME wrapping (4-space grants, 8-space continuation lines). The other cases follow that format: the intended helper-only grant, and Sol 6's round-3 group-grant counterexample as sudo -l shows it after expanding %group.

cases.name: real-operator
cases.text:
Matching Defaults entries for operator on host-a:
    secure_path=/usr/local/sbin\:/usr/local/bin\:/usr/bin, passwd_tries=10

Runas and Command-specific defaults for operator:
    Defaults!/usr/bin/tool-v env_keep+="SUDO_EDITOR EDITOR VISUAL"

User operator may run the following commands on host-a:
    (ALL) ALL
    (ALL) !/usr/bin/tool-a
    (root) NOPASSWD: /usr/bin/tool-a ^--detect (/dev/(usb/)?hiddev[0-9]+)(
        /dev/(usb/)?hiddev[0-9]+)*$, /usr/bin/tool-a
        ^/dev/(usb/)?hiddev[0-9]+$, /usr/bin/tool-a
        ^/dev/(usb/)?hiddev[0-9]+ -- [+-]?[0-9]{1,3}%$
    (root) NOPASSWD: /usr/bin/tool-b one, /usr/bin/tool-b
        two, /usr/bin/tool-b three
    (root) NOPASSWD: /usr/bin/tool-c
        [0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f]
    (root) NOPASSWD: /usr/bin/tool-d ^set-zone
        [A-Za-z0-9_+][A-Za-z0-9_+.-]*(/[A-Za-z0-9_+][A-Za-z0-9_+.-]*)*$

cases.name: helper-only
cases.text:
Matching Defaults entries for runner on host-a:
    env_reset, !setenv, secure_path=/usr/sbin\:/usr/bin\:/sbin\:/bin

User runner may run the following commands on host-a:
    (root) NOPASSWD: /usr/local/libexec/flightctl-helper
